item.title: OnAir Pro 4.36
item.description:
What's New in OnAir Pro 4.36

  • ConfigManager: migrate auto for missing/legacy keys
  • Add documentation header + alphabetical sorting
  • Centralize file rendering via renderConfigFile
  • Add min_recording_seconds to defaults
  • Remove shortcut_name (legacy)
  • Meeting recap ready now uses OnAir notifications.

item.title: OnAir Pro 4.35
item.description:
What's New in OnAir Pro 4.35

  • Redesigned the first-launch setup experience.
  • OnAir now works without a physical device.
  • Improved device code validation.
  • Improved configuration screen to not interrupt recording when saving.
  • Adjusted prompt for better results.
  • Added documentation for cfg file.
